verdict.rationale: Reading codes on a smartwatch is a fair question for a mobile authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a smartwatch or wearable app. The general claim of syncing 'across all your devices' is about phones and other devices signing in to a Google Account, not a watch surface, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone
